pretreatments.description: Mechanical milling and screening to a size <1 mm
Liquid hot water (LHW) pretreatment at 121 °C for 60 min, with or without non-ionic surfactants (PEG 6000, Triton X-100, or Tween 80) at a dose of 1.5% (w/v)
Organosolve pretreatment using 60% ethanol at 121 °C for 60 min, with or without non-ionic surfactants (PEG 6000, Triton X-100, or Tween 80) at a dose of 1.5% (w/v)

Dilute acid pretreatment using H2SO4 (concentrations ranging from 1% to 3%, w/v) at 121 °C for 60 min, with or without non-ionic surfactants (PEG 6000, Triton X-100, or Tween 80), specifically PEG 6000 at doses of 0-1.5% (w/v)
Dilute alkali pretreatment using 0.5% NaOH at 121 °C for 60 min, with or without non-ionic surfactants (PEG 6000, Triton X-100, or Tween 80) at a dose of 1.5% (w/v)
Enzymatic hydrolysis using cellulase (Cellic CTec2) at a dose of 20 FPU/g dry substrate in pH 4.8 acetate buffer at 50 °C for 72 h
Simultaneous saccharification and fermentation (SSF) using cellulase (15 FPU/g pretreated SCB) and Saccharomyces cerevisiae at 34 °C for 72 h at pH 4.5
Neutralization of prehydrolysate with 5 M Na2CO3 to achieve a pH range of 6.50-7.00
